handoff.R_PAST_LIMIT.failure: 0284: an agent in a run keeps working with a context past the limit, so its calls run on a context the operator capped and nothing hands the work to a fresh agent

handoff.R_HANDOFF_WRITTEN.failure: 0284: an agent past the limit whose hand-off is written goes on reading or writing, so the hand-off it wrote no longer matches the work it hands on

handoff.R_PAST_LIMIT_INLINE.failure: 0284: an agent without the Write tool past the limit keeps working, because no file write can stop it

handoff.R_NO_HANDOFF_FILE.failure: 0284: a link or a folder planted at the hand-off path turns the one admitted write into a write somewhere else

handoff.R_UNMEASURED.failure: 0284: an agent whose context size cannot be read runs unchecked during a run, so a forged or broken transcript path turns the limit off; a hook input with no transcript path at all runs with a warning, because only the client can leave that field out
